name: Necromancer: Master Animator raises the Life Force capacity from 2 to 3 (#1925)
contract: Master Animator 504431 (CharacterAdvancement 7117, Necromancer Animation tab, 1 talent point) reads 'Increases
your maximum Life Force by 1.' Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), MiscValue 31
(SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS, the Ascension operation), EffectBasePoints 0 + DieSides 1 = +1, class mask word 1 =
0x20000 in SpellFamilyName 29, which selects only the two Life Force auras 805011 (capacity, StackAmount 2)
and 525004 (free capacity). Scourge Apprentice Training 680283 carries the same effect. The #1925 audit read
the absence of 504431 from the source as a missing handler, but the modifier is native: the Necromancer
capacity starts at 2 and applies SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS for 805011, whose stack count the server keeps equal
to the capacity. A level-8 Necromancer (below Scourge Apprentice Training's level 10) without Life Force
passives has capacity 2; learning Master Animator makes it 3 (805011 stacks 3, 525004 free stacks 3). Raise:
Lesser Skeletal Warrior 500970 occupies 1 Life Force and costs 32% of base mana, so three warriors fit, which
a capacity of 2 refuses, and a fourth is refused with SPELL_FAILED_ALREADY_HAVE_SUMMON (7) while the three

steps.label: Let the Life Force aura synchronize
PRECONDITION: Life Force capacity is 2 without Life Force talents
DISCRIMINATING: Master Animator raises the Life Force capacity to 3
All 3 Life Force are free before any raise
Raise the first Lesser Skeletal Warrior
One Lesser Skeletal Warrior is raised
Raise the second Lesser Skeletal Warrior
Two Lesser Skeletal Warriors are raised
Raise a third warrior into the talented Life Force
DISCRIMINATING: the third Lesser Skeletal Warrior fits into capacity 3
No Life Force is left free
Raise a fourth with no free Life Force
The capacity is exactly 3: the fourth raise is refused (7)
The three raised warriors stay and no fourth appears
